prompt.value: In a quiz competition, eight students are competing, each assigned a roll number from 1 to 8. What is the probability that only students with prime-numbered roll numbers (i.e., 2, 3, 5, 7) secure the top four ranks, in any order? Enter the answer correct to three decimal places.

A company has 15 offices and wants to set up two-way communication between every pair of offices. However, the 3 smallest offices will not have direct communication with one another, though each of them can still connect directly with the remaining offices. How many communication channels are needed in total?

A group of 4 teachers and 4 students is to be seated around a circular table for a discussion. They decide that all students must sit together. Find the number of ways they can be seated around the table such that all students are sitting together.
A basket contains 5 red balls and 4 green balls. If 3 balls are to be selected at random without replacement, in how many ways can the balls be selected such that at least one green ball is included?
How many 5-digit numbers can be formed using the digits 0, 2, 3, 4, and 7 where digits may be repeated such that the number is divisible by 2 ?

A box C contains 3 white balls and 2 black balls, while box D contains 4 white balls and 3 black balls. One ball is randomly selected from box C and transferred to box D. After the transfer, one ball is drawn at random from box D. What is the probability that the ball drawn from box D is black? Enter the answer correct to three decimal places.
In how many different ways can the letters of the word ‘ARTICLE’ be arranged such that all the vowels always come together?

A committee of 3 people is to be formed from a group of n people. The number of possible committees in which two particular people A and B are both included together is 7. Find the number of ways in which committee can be formed.
